text:
meera: FYI Bluejay dropped two LoRA adapters + a tiny tokenizer patch to our intake bucket. Need a fast compatibility probe before we hand this to SRE/customer. Goals: tokenization sanity, quantized delta, and a minimal regen repro set.

alex: Happy to run. What base and adapter order? Any KV-warmstart needed?

jamal: Base: gptx-7b-cust. Apply dialog.loRA then instruct.loRA. Tokenizer adds a special token <cust_tok> and remaps a small numeric subrange (0-9) to new ids. Warmstart prefix recommended to exercise KV cache.

sara: Heads-up on numeric remap — last time that caused embedding drift and some token aliasing. Keep an eye on mean cosine sim.

meera: Smoketest checklist: 1) tokenization roundtrip diff (orig vs patched) on 2000 examples, 2) perplexity float32 vs int8 vs int4, 3) top-1 token probability shifts per prompt, flag >0.15, 4) embedding cos-sim vs reference vectors (mean/std), 5) small regen A/B on 20 prompts (dialog/instruction/edge). Also sample KV warmstart.

alex: I'll assemble 25 prompts: 10 dialog, 10 instruct, 5 numeric-edge. Plan: run float32 baseline, then int8, then int4. Will collect token-level probs and embeddings.

jamal: Add tokenmap unit that verifies special token inserted at same split boundaries and a numeric tokenizer test. If token ids differ for numeric tokens, mark those prompts for focused repro.

ci-bot: Job queued: run/bluejay-compat-probe-3180001234 (queued)

alex: Local run command I'm using:

```
python -m ci.eval \ 
  --model gptx-7b-cust \ 
  --adapters dialog.lora,instruct.lora \ 
  --tokenizer-patch bluejay_tok.json \ 
  --quant-modes float32,int8,int4 \ 
  --prompts smoke_prompts.json \ 
  --warmstart-prefix "[ws]" \ 
  --collect token_probs,embeddings \ 
  --out s3://redwood-ci/bluejay/3180001234/results.zip
```

meera: Capture per-token KL and top-1 prob diffs. If any prompt has top-1 shift > 0.15 float32->int4, fallback to int8 in the customer note.

sara: Also compute embedding cosine similarity to 5 stored refs and attach a simple plot (mean/std).

ci-bot: CI started: run/bluejay-compat-probe-3180001234 10:12:05Z50

ci-bot: step: setup -> done

jamal: Pushed tokenmap tests PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/912 adds tokenizer roundtrip checks and numeric remap verifiers.

alex: int8 run finished locally, uploading artifacts now. Starting int4 next.

ci-bot: CI finished: SUCCESS. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bluejay/3180001234/results.zip

alex: Quick summary from results.zip:
- prompt_03 (numeric-edge): top-1 shift float32->int4 = 0.28 (formatting token split changed)
- prompt_11 (dialog): top-1 shift = 0.17 (special token boundary altered)
- embedding cos-sim drops: mean 0.94 (float32) -> 0.88 (int4) for the numeric subset
All other prompts top-1 shifts < 0.08, embeddings within 0.02 mean.

sara: Confirms tokenizer numeric remap is the likely root. Tokenizer roundtrip test shows remapped ids for "7" and "9" falling into new multi-token sequences.

meera: Actionable items: 1) Recommend int8 for production until tokenizer patch is updated, 2) jamal to create a tokenizer pre-tokenize remap option for customer, 3) alex to prepare minimal repro (prompts 03 and 11) + suggested patch diff, 4) sara to generate embedding drift plots for the report.

alex: Uploaded repro and patch suggestion: s3://redwood-ci/bluejay/3180001234/repro_prompts_03_11.tar.gz and a small tokenizer diff in the PR.

ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/bluejay/3180001234/repro_prompts_03_11.tar.gz

jamal: I'll add a targeted unit to pre-tokenize numerics for the next intake and rerun the probe once patched. ETA for patch PR: 2 business days.

meera: Great. I'll draft an account-facing note: summary, attached artifacts, recommended mitigation (use int8 + apply tokenizer fix), and timeline. Will loop in AE after jamal confirms PR. :email:

alex: Thanks team  good triage cycle.

ci-bot: run/bluejay-compat-probe-3180001234 archived.
